items.text: Malik Nabers (knee) active after true game-time decision; family skipped game as he was unsure until ~2 hours pre-kickoff.
items.why: Officially active SNF; detailed late decision per Schefter/Raanan.
items.implication: Start everywhere despite decoy risk; monitored knee.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play / inactive Week 1; status directly impacts Travis Etienne projection and opportunity.
items.why: Weekend reports and inactives confirmed not expected/inactive after knee issue.
items.implication: Etienne elevated to lead back role with top-10 upside on volume.
items.opportunity: Bulk carries + passing downs for Etienne

items.text: Jonathan Taylor heavy usage even in loss: 89% snaps, 59% routes, 96% RB opportunities, 13% target share; Colts distrust backups.
items.why: Post-game snap/route/opportunity data; historical loss struggles noted but volume holds.
items.implication: Locked RB1 every week; floor secured by role.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early; injury not serious, day-to-day, MRI upcoming; would have returned in playoff scenario.
items.why: Sources to Rapoport post-game; ETR watching list.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2; short-term depth chart opportunity if limited.
items.opportunity: Possible reduced snaps if held out; backups elevate

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1.
items.implication: TE1 upside weekly starter; buy if available.

items.text: Start Malik Nabers everywhere post-active; risk-reward with possible decoy but play him.
items.why: Berry reaction to actives/inactives; decoy risk acknowledged.

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) ruled OUT with fractured wrist; several weeks absence, further MRI.
items.why: Ruled out mid-game; Rapoport/Garafolo fracture diagnosis.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thinned with Flowers also dinged; monitor targets elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for other Ravens WRs

items.text: A.J. Brown (high ankle) no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: Schefter update paired with other injury news.
items.implication: NE/PHI WR depth chart shift; long-term stash, short waiver adds.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) OUT Week 1 with realistic chance return Week 2 vs Chargers; team monitoring.
items.why: Post-surgery update; realistic W2 return possible.
items.implication: Michael Mayer elevated short-term; Bowers stash ROS.
items.opportunity: TE targets/snaps to Mayer/others in LV

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play and confirmed active Week 1 after limited practice.
items.why: ETR weekend summary expected; Schefter/others confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable RB2/flex with risk-reward; limited workhorse projection.
items.opportunity: RB2 depth chart snaps/carries vs Chargers

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) expected to play and officially active Week 1.
items.why: ETR summary + Schefter confirmation of active.
items.implication: Full WR role in high-scoring Bears offense; start confidently.

items.text: Josh Downs stayed on for 2-WR sets: 32 routes on 34 Daniel Jones dropbacks.
items.why: Route participation data answering slot persistence question.
items.implication: High-floor slot WR with consistent opportunity.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes even in lighter personnel

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible despite quiet Week 1.
items.why: Response to panic; preseason strong take unchanged.
items.implication: Hold/buy TE1; Week 1 anomaly in high-scoring offense.
items.conflict: Quiet production vs high snap/preseason hype

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason talk; new OC Mannion fit.
items.implication: Viable WR starter/flex in PHI offense.
